verdict.rationale: Slate is a coding-agent CLI that runs on a hosted service with accounts, subscriptions and credits, so issuing scoped tokens for headless or agent use is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no way to mint API keys or tokens, scoped or otherwise, and every OpenAPI probe returned 404. Its allow/ask/deny permission rules only control which tool actions the agent may take locally; they are not credential issuance, so they are not credited here.
